headline: Week 17: Championship Weekend And Szara Shows Up With A Wet Sock
subhead: Four winners punched playoff-shaped tickets while 226 Alpha left a buffet on the bench and called it a meal.
matchOfTheWeek: Hot Cocks vs. LargestofRocks was the only game with a pulse — 10.10 points of sweat. Baker Mayfield went full pirate for 34.56 and BigD ran a 94.8% efficient lineup like an actual adult. Meanwhile LargestofRocks got 36.30 from Trey McBride AND 32.78 from Jayden Daniels and STILL lost because Zach Ertz was rotting on the bench for 28.20. Imagine starting two top-3 scorers at their position and choking — that's a LargestofRocks signature dish.
powerRankingsShakeup: Put an AR to My Head looks like a buzzsaw heading into next year after dropping 173.52, while 226 Alpha plummets straight through the floor and into the parking garage with a 79.76 that included seventy. point. nine. zero. on the bench.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the crime scene: Szara, my brother in Christ, you scored 79.76 and your optimal lineup was 150.66. That's not a lineup mistake, that's a hostage situation. You left 70.90 points on the pine — including 25.90 from Michael Pittman — and somehow still showed up Sunday like you were trying. 226 Alpha didn't lose a matchup, he lost a bet with himself.

MassiveCocks bullied Bo Nix Celli 170.30 to 153.92 on the back of Tee Higgins (40.10) and Malik Nabers (36.10), which is a cute story until you notice Celli had Marvin Mims dropping 30.20 ON HIS BENCH. Nick, you named the team after a QB and still can't read a waiver wire. That's a special kind of self-own.

OnlyFants smacked The Good Ladds 167.34 to 149.52 because Brock Purdy decided to remember he's good (32.28), and Mig got to spend Championship Sunday watching Cubby celebrate. Devastating visual.

Put an AR to My Head put an AR to The Olave Garden's head — 173.52 to 155.14 — and the funniest part is Patrick got 36.98 from Joe Burrow and STILL got curb-stomped by 18. When your franchise QB throws for 400 and you lose by three scores, the problem isn't the QB, it's everything else you've assembled around him like a Build-A-Bear with no stuffing.

And shoutout to T swift's Baddies for leading the league with 175.98 in a week he didn't even have a matchup that mattered — Drew Lock and DeVonta Smith carrying like it's a side quest, while Ricky Pearsall (28.70) and Alec Pierce (24.20) sat on the bench like a $300 bottle of wine at a Chili's. Tnicolle, you're scoring 175 in exhibition mode. Touch grass.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Got 36.98 from Burrow and still ate an 18-point L — Patrick's roster is one star and eleven stowaways.

weeklyAwards.title: Cocky Winner Energy
weeklyAwards.blurb: 94.8% lineup efficiency and a 10-point squeaker — celebrate quietly, you beat a guy whose bench outscored half the league.

weeklyAwards.title: Meaningless Points King
weeklyAwards.blurb: Led the league at 175.98 with another 50+ on the bench — congrats on winning a week nobody asked you to play.
